title: Market Recovery, Fed Bailout, Iran, War, Oil, Micron
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Talks are stalled but Trump is being deliberately patient to extract a better deal; expects a deal before midterms, timing unknown.
ADP 90k beat, Chicago PMI 58.8 highest since May, PCE cooler than expected: bullish for the economy.
Delay on Iran plus strong data keep upward pressure on yields despite Williams' dovish talk and Treasury's Oct 1 buyback; yields need an Iran deal to fall.
Losses in financial activities and professional/business services in ADP may be an early sign of AI-driven job cuts.
A US diesel export ban would likely raise diesel/gasoline prices over time, not lower them.

calls.reason: Past peak fear (bought heavily near 700); holding above 735 is a bullish indicator; strong data and market pricing in a likely Iran deal.
calls.quote: We are now riding above 735 which is a bullish indicator that we might be getting to all-time highs by next Friday.

calls.condition: Yields come down meaningfully only once an Iran deal is struck
calls.reason: Bear steepening, rising 5y breakevens; Williams and the Treasury buyback cannot control yields while Trump delays the deal.
calls.quote: to meaningfully get yields down, we still need this because then we could actually have a situation where the economy is doing very well
